snippet.title: Game Boy Advance Longplay [113] SpongeBob SquarePants - Revenge of the Flying Dutchman
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: NPI

SpongeBob game that was released during the first few seasons of the show.

I had to go back to level 2-1 (at 02:08:48) because I missed 5 coins. Apparently, the more coins you collect the more endings you get to chose. At the end of the game you have 6 choices to make, which I showed in this longplay. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
